svg.aria-label: From a Monday cron to a discard on every device: 1. Schedule: CronJob fstrim runs Mondays at 00:00 with one pod per node. A run never overlaps the last, and a start more than 10 minutes late is skipped. 2. Enter: Each pod uses nsenter to join the kubelet's mount and network namespaces through /host/proc, so it sees the mounts that Ceph PVs live in. 3. Select: awk reads mountinfo, keeps one mount per device (globalmount first), and skips read-only mounts and sources that are not under /dev. 4. Trim: fstrim -v runs on each target. Any device that fails fails the run. A mount that vanished mid-run is skipped, not counted as a failure. 5. Watch: FstrimJobFailed fires when the latest run failed or no run has succeeded for 8 days, and clears on the next good run.
